notes:
Snapshot: Lighthouse is a mid-market SaaS vendor providing a hosted knowledge-base + chat product for enterprise support teams. They ingest customer docs, KB articles and tooling logs into a RAG pipeline. Primary ask: embeddings + reranking at scale (moderate index size, very high QPS).

Key technical constraints / targets (from call with CTO - Maria Velasquez):
- Indexing: ~12 million documents (mostly short articles, avg 300 tokens) -> expect ~12M vectors (1536-d).
- Query profile: 95th perc. peak ~1,000 - 1,200 QPS during business hours; baseline ~200 QPS.
- Latency SLOs: 95th percentile end-to-end for user query (retrieve + rerank + compose) <= 200ms ideal, acceptable <= 350ms.
- Cost sensitivity: target cost per query <$0.0015-0.002 (embeddings + rerank budget), finance wants modeled monthly TCO for 1k QPS sustained.
- Architecture preference: hybrid flow — approximate ANN retrieval (user curated candidate set) + lightweight cross-encoder reranker for top-10. They currently run FAISS on prem for dev; want hosted API for prod to reduce ops.
- Feature asks: token-level costing breakdown, per-route latency charts, autoscaling for burst-to-1.5k QPS, model fallback policies when capacity constrained.

Security / compliance notes:
- SSO (Okta) required, SCIM would be nice.
- Audit logging and configurable retention policies (30/90/365d) are mandatory for certain customers.
- Data residency: some EU customers require EU-only storage; need confirmation of hosted regions.

POC plan agreed 2026-03-04:
- Redwood to provision hosted API sandbox with dedicated rate-limited credentials.
- Lighthouse to stream a 10% sample (~1.2M docs) for initial throughput tests.
- Synthetic load generator to emulate 1.2k QPS with mixed query distribution (short support queries + multi-turn followups).
- Measure: ingest latency (supply pipeline), retrieval 95p, rerank 95p, end-to-end, per-token cost breakdown.
- Deliverable: performance/cost report + recommended batching/quantization profile, suggested routing policy for latency/cost tradeoffs.
